# Ziemia Jałowa — Krzywol’s retrospective

- Original source: [ROBIN HOOD - Legenda Sherwood](https://gryziemiajalowa.blogspot.com/2012/05/robin-hood-legenda-sherwood.html)
- Author / publication: Krzywol; Ziemia Jałowa.
- Language / date: Polish; 2012-05-03.
- Access: Substantial indexed article passages, author, and date inspected; direct retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Krzywol describes Robin Hood as the first game of this tactical style they completed after failing to connect with Commandos. The review particularly enjoys forest ambushes, environmental traps, and the freedom to improvise once a convoy has stopped. Camp production and the recruitment consequences of killing are presented as reasons to preserve enemies’ lives.

The strongest visual praise goes to the painted maps rather than character animation. The author compares the atmosphere with the Errol Flynn film and distinguishes convincing medieval scenery from accurate geography, noting that the game’s York differs from their own visit. This is personal reception, not historical verification.
